Set this directory up for a Voidhash project: sign in if needed, choose or create the organization
and project, and write voidhash.json, which names the project for every command run here and is
meant to be committed.

What else is written depends on the app found here:
  a JavaScript project (package.json)
      the React Native SDK client, in src/lib or lib, with the project's
      publishable key, and the TypeScript declarations voidhash.gen.d.ts
  an Xcode project or a Swift package
      Swift types of the project's product, location and perk slugs
  a Gradle project
      Kotlin types of the same

The command asks before it replaces a configuration or a file it did not generate; --yes answers
yes. Off a terminal, pass --project.

Usage:
  voidhash init [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --project <project>  The project to set up for: its slug, organization/slug, name or id
                           (default: asks)
  -y, --yes                Replace an existing configuration and files without asking

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash init
  voidhash init --project acme/app --yes
